answer: Gale-window sealed-bid voyage auction: each epoch opens a gale window with 100 berths. Each identity files one cipher-sealed bid; bids open after the window, top bids win and pay, losers keep their money. The k-th fake pays 40 plus 5 per berth already taken; 1,000 fakes pay 2,537,500 against a 40,000 pool. Bids sharing one cipher key or funding source void every berth they touch. An honest agent bids once, wins one berth, sails its voyage.
